Dress Code for The Company
The Company Employees are to keep a neat, clean, professional appearance at all times. Anyone
violating their Brand’s Dress code policy will be sent home to change into proper work attire and
may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and potentially including termination.

All Locations Dress Code:
Name tags
o Name tags are to be worn and visible at all times while working.
o Each Employee will receive one name tag.
o Additional or replacement tags can be ordered through a manager at the Employee’s
expense.

Shoes
o Tennis shoes or other full coverage closed toe shoes are to be worn.
o No sandals, crocks, flip-flops, or other open toe shoes are allowed.
o Shoes must be tied at all times and must be clean with no holes.

Belts
o Belts are to be dark brown or black.
o Belts are not to hang down or have objects (cell phones, pagers, chains, keys, etc.) hanging
from them.

Hair
o Hair of all lengths and colors are acceptable as long as it is clean, groomed, and kept out of
employee’s face and eyes.

Facial Hair
o Facial hair is acceptable as long as it is clean, well-groomed, and trimmed.

Make-up
o Due to the nature of working in the Beauty Industry, reasonable and natural make-up is
acceptable and encouraged.

Jewelry/Accessories
o Jewelry that does not interfere with work is acceptable.
o No dangling earrings or chains, and no pins or buttons allowed on the shirt unless approved
by Management.

Tattoos
o Large, inappropriate, or offensive tattoos must be covered. All other tattoos are acceptable
as long as they are not discriminatory or offensive in nature.

Crunch Fitness Specific Dress Code:

Shirts
o Two uniform shirts will be provided to all Employees upon hire.
o Full-time Employees will receive an additional 1-2 shirts.
o Employee may also wear a plain black, white, or gray long sleeve shirt underneath their
branded shirt when cold.
o Group Fitness Instructors (Crunch Fitness) teaching classes that are not proprietary to
Crunch Fitness, i.e., Zumba, Pound, etc. may wear fitness style apparel or branding related
to class style.
o Shirts should not be shorter than the beltline, exposing the stomach area or low cut to
expose the chest area.
o Shirts must be clean and free of wrinkles.
o No patches, rips, or holes are to be noticeable on the shirt.

Pants
o Yoga pants, joggers, or sweats are approved for Instructors ONLY (preferably solid black).
o Front Desk and Management’s pants must be solid khaki or black in color.
o Pants must be full length and free of holes or frayed edges.

Buff City Soap:

Shirts
o Any BCS Employee can wear any plain black, white, or gray t-shirt or long-sleeved shirt to
wear under their branded apron.
o Employees can also wear any Branded top.
o Shirts should not be shorter than the beltline, exposing the stomach area or low cut to
expose the chest area.
o Shirts must be clean and free from wrinkles.

o No patches, rips, or holes are to be noticeable on the shirt.

Pants
o Full length black or blue jean-colored pants are acceptable.
o Yoga pants, joggers or sweats are never to be worn while at work.

Sun Tan City:

Shirts
o Any STC Employee can wear any Branded top or black collared or black t-shirt.
o ASD and above can wear any colored collared shirt.
o Any STC Employee can wear any gray, black or white plain jacket.
o Shirts should not be shorter than the beltline, exposing the stomach area or low cut to
expose the chest area.
o Shirts must be clean and free from wrinkles.
o No patches, rips, or holes are to be noticeable on the shirt

Pants
o Full length khaki/black pants or jeans (no holes, rips or patches) are acceptable.
o Yoga pants, joggers or sweats are never to be worn while at work.
o Shorts that sit at or below the knee are acceptable: i.e., Bermuda shorts or Capris.

Tanning
o Employees are expected to maintain a consistent tanning schedule in accordance with
company appearance standards.

JB & Associates Office:

Shirts
o Any JBA franchise Branded top
o Fitted blouse or collared shirts
o Sundresses
o Shirts should not be shorter than the beltline, exposing the stomach area or low cut to
expose the chest area.
o Shirts must be clean and free from wrinkles.
o No patches, rips, or holes are to be noticeable on the shirt.

Pants
o Full length khaki or black pants are acceptable.
o Full length black or blue jean-colored pants are acceptable as long as they are free of tears
or excessive distressing.
o Shorts that sit at or below the knee are acceptable: i.e., Bermuda shorts or Capris.
o Skirts that sit at or below the knee.
All aspects of the dress code are at The Company’s discretion, if an employee has a question, please
check with management prior to wearing.

Personal Items:
Personal items (books, laptops, other electronics, etc.) do not belong inside The Company,
unless necessary. Employees are expected to tend to company business while at work, not their
own business. The Company assumes no risk or liability for any theft or damage that may occur
to Employee property while it is on company property.

Employee Parking
Employees are not allowed to park directly in front of the location. Parking spaces closest to the
front of the location are to be reserved for customers. The Company assumes no risk or liability
for any theft or damage that may occur to Employee vehicles or the contents of Employee
vehicles while they are on company property.

Lost and Found
All Employees are responsible for securing lost and found items.
o Follow these instructions when an employee locates lost and found items:
▪ Place the item in an envelope with the Lost and Found Tracker form stapled to the
outside OR place the item in a clear Ziploc bag with this form inside.
▪ Fill out the Lost and Found Tracker form and follow up properly until the customer
has picked up the item.
▪ All items worth 50 dollars or more should be kept in the drop safe (this includes;
jewelry, cellphones, etc.) All items worth less than 50 dollars should be kept in a box
(socks, hats, shirts, eyewear, etc.)
▪ Notify managers if a customer has not picked up the item within 60 days.
o If an item is found by an Employee, it is their legal responsibility to return it to the rightful
owner. Deviations from this policy will not be tolerated. Items found must be returned to
the customer or criminal suits may follow.

Facility Repair/Service Vendors
Whenever a contracted repair/service vendor enters the workplace to fix a facility issue or
provide services other than the normal monthly scheduled work such as rug replacement,
window cleaning, etc., the employee must immediately contact the location manager on duty
PRIOR to letting them complete any work or access any facilities or systems. If there are no
members of Management present, call up the chain of command until one is reached.
To protect company Employees, customers, our data and facilities, employees must receive the
approval of a member of Management, who should confirm the repair was requested and
expected, before employees allow the repair vendor to do any work or to access any of our
facilities or systems. Failure to get approval/access permission prior to allowing a repair or
service vendor to access our systems or facilities may result in disciplinary action, up to and
including immediate termination as allowing potential unauthorized access puts our entire
company, Employees, and customers at risk.

Purchasing Authorizations
Employees do not have authority to verbally represent or sign anything, other than acceptance
of normal business deliveries and regularly scheduled routine services, on behalf of The

Company, unless given prior approval in writing by Upper Management, official company
directive, or the legal department. Employees are prohibited from signing any contracts or legal
agreements on behalf of The Company, without specific approval of the Owner. Employees are
prohibited from purchasing any products, supplies, or services for use at any company location
without express written approval from Upper Management, regardless of whether or not the
Employee expects to receive reimbursement for the expense.

Discounting
The only discounting allowed by The Company is in conjunction with a pre-approved
promotional offer. A coupon must accompany the applied discount unless specified otherwise
by Management or company communications regarding approved discount offers.
The only use of the manual discount/price override function by non-Management personnel
should be for Employee purchases. Only members of Management are allowed to give manual
discounts/price overrides for transactions other than Employee purchases. Employee purchases
must be processed on the Employee’s account. Any deviation from this policy will result in
immediate termination.

Coupon Collection
Anytime employees collect a promotional coupon from a customer, the following steps must be
taken:
o Printed Coupons – Collect the coupon from the customer.
o Non-Printed Coupons – For example: Coupons shown from a cell phone -
▪ Print the receipt after the transaction is processed. Write the promotional offer the
customer has shown using their phone on a receipt. The receipt in turn becomes
their coupon.
o Write employee name, the customer's name, the customer number, the date, and “VOID”
across the coupon.
o Include all coupons with nightly deposit at the end of the shift.

Cell Phone/Smart Watch Policy
Personal Employee cell phones are permitted in the workplace but must be kept out of sight. It
is the Employee’s personal responsibility to protect the customer’s experience and doing things
such as texting, making phone calls or using social media jeopardizes the customer’s experience.
Employees should keep cell phones on silent and not on their person (this means not in back
pockets, charging in the break room, or sitting on top of a drawer till). The only time that a cell
phone should be accessed while clocked in is in emergency situations.
Smart Watches are allowed as long as they are not being used for social media or texting/phone
calls. We reserve the right to ask Employees to remove any smart watch if it starts to interfere
with the customer's experience.

Company Email Account
Only authorized Employees may access their company email and may not use their company
email for personal use.

Point of Sale and Alarm Passwords
Employees must always use their own personal passwords and alarm codes. Do NOT share
alarm codes or passwords. Using the password or alarm code of another Employee or giving
another Employee individual passwords or alarm codes, for any reason, is a violation of policy
and may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

Employment Verification
Employment verification, both current and previous, is to be handled by the Corporate Office. If
employees are asked to verify or comment on any aspect of an Employee’s current or past
history with The Company, employees are to refer the inquiry to the Corporate Office with
Human Resources.

Outside Employment
The Company requires that any outside employment not compromise the company’s interests,
adversely affect the employee’s job performance and ability to fulfill all responsibilities to the
company or create a liability for the company. Working for a direct competitor is strictly
prohibited.
Managers are strictly prohibited from working another job. It is the manager's responsibility to
be available at all times to tend to the business of the location. Managers are allowed to attend
school; however, all class schedules must be approved in advance by the District Manager and
are expected to not interfere with the Manager’s availability.

Fraternization Policy
All Employees are strongly discouraged from dating other Employees. Anyone in a Supervisory
position is prohibited from dating a subordinate, without Management Team approval. Personal
relationships between Employees should not unfavorably impact either Employee’s morale or
the effectiveness of company operations. Employees who are considering possibly engaging in a
personal relationship that would result in potential violations of this policy must contact Human
Resources. Deviation from this policy will result in immediate termination.

Important Notes:
o Exempt (salaried) Employees must use their accrued PTO, as instructed (See the Paid Time
Off (PTO) section), to receive pay for days where they are absent from work for personal
reasons, illness, or disability, and to ensure they have enough hours reported combining
their actual hours worked and their PTO hours to retain their full-time Employee status.
o PTO may not be utilized when an Employee is placed on unpaid suspension. (See the Paid
Time Off (PTO) section).
o Finally, as a public sector employer, The Company operates under principles of public
accountability, which permit deductions from the pay of an exempt (salaried) Employee for

partial-day or full-day absences due to illness, injury, or personal reasons when accrued paid
leave is not used by an Employee because:
o The Employee has not yet qualified to receive PTO.
o Permission for PTO use has not been sought or has been sought and denied.
o Accrued PTO has been exhausted (See the Paid Time Off (PTO) section).
o For all full-time Employees, time off without pay that would result in the total hours worked
by the Employee in any workweek dropping below thirty (30) hours is not permitted without
prior written approval from your Supervisor and the Human Resources department.
o The Company has classified those positions which are considered to be “exempt”.
o It is the policy of The Company to comply with the “salary basis” requirements of the FLSA
regarding exempt Employees.
o If you believe that an improper deduction has been made to your salary, you should
immediately report this information to Human Resources.
o Reports of an improper deduction from wages will be promptly investigated. If it is
determined that an improper deduction has occurred, you will be promptly reimbursed
(typically on the next regular pay date) for any improper deduction.

Salary Administration
The salary administration program at The Company was created to achieve consistent pay
practices, comply with federal and state laws, mirror our commitment to Equal Employment
Opportunity, and offer competitive salaries within our labor market.
Compensation for every position is determined by several factors which includes job analysis
and evaluation, essential job duties, and responsibilities of the job. Merit-based pay adjustments
may be awardee in conjunction with superior employee performance during the annual
performance evaluation process.

Employee Benefits

Paid time Off (PTO)
Paid Time Off (PTO) hours are hours issued to eligible employees that can be used for paid time
away from work for vacation, personal time, personal illness, or time off to care for dependents.
The PTO policy replaces sick, absence, personal, and vacation time. All state and local guidelines
regarding mandated additional sick time will be followed.

Eligibility
All salaried managers, full-time corporate office personnel, and full-time Assistant Salon
Directors/Assistant Makery Managers begin accruing PTO after 90 days of employment in that
position. PTO is not issued to temporary or contract employees.

Provisions
For qualifying full-time Employees, PTO accrues as follows:
o 90 days – 4 years of service in a full-time position – 2 weeks (80 hours), with a maximum
accrual cap of 120 hours.

o 5-9 years of service in a full-time position – 3 weeks (120 hours), with a maximum accrual
cap of 160 hours.
o 10+ years of service in a full-time position – 4 weeks (160 hours), with a maximum accrual
cap of 200 hours
Unused PTO is carried over from one calendar year to the next; however, employees may not
exceed the accrual cap for their respective tier. Once the cap is reached, no further PTO accrual
will occur until PTO is used and the balance drops below the cap.

Usage
Qualified salaried Employees must schedule PTO in half day (4 hours), or full day (8 hours)
increments only. No PTO is permitted during peak business seasons as listed below:
o Sun Tan City – February 1 and June 1
o Buff City Soap – November 1 and December 31
o Crunch – January 1 and February 28
PTO should be requested in the Personnel System at least two weeks in advance. In unforeseen
circumstances where advance notice is not possible, employees must notify their supervisor
directly via phone immediately and enter the PTO request into the Personnel System as soon as
possible.
PTO must be approved by the immediate Supervisor. PTO will be granted so long as it does not
place undue hardship on the business. Only one team member from a location/department will
be approved to take PTWO at the same time unless otherwise approved by the supervisor.
All State and Federal guidelines will be followed regarding paying out accrued PTO upon
termination of employment.

Holiday Benefits
Each FT salaried manager and FT corporate staff member will receive 8 hours of pay for each
holiday.

Corporate Office:
The Corporate Office is closed on the below listed holidays. These holidays are paid holidays for
salaried managers and full-time staff:
o New Years Day
o Thanksgiving Day
o Christmas Day
o Memorial Day
o Independence Day
o Labor Day

Sun Tan City:
Sun Tan City is closed on the below listed holidays. These holidays are paid holidays for salaried
managers and full-time staff:

o New Years Day
o Independence Day
o Thanksgiving Day
o Christmas Day
o Easter
The salons will be open on Memorial Day.

Crunch Fitness:
Crunch Fitness is closed on the below listed holidays. These holidays are paid holidays for
salaried managers and full-time staff:
o Thanksgiving Day
o Christmas Day

Bereavement Leave
Employees who wish to take time off due to the death of an immediate family member should
notify their Supervisor and payroll immediately. Up to 3 consecutive days of paid Bereavement
Leave will be provided to all Employees provided the leave is approved and the days requested
are days the Employee was already scheduled to work. If the Employee was not scheduled to
work during the requested days, they would not receive pay as no bereavement time would be
required. The 3 consecutive days requested should include the day of the funeral and 2 days
either immediately prior to or immediately following the day of the funeral.
For the purposes of the Bereavement Policy, The Company defines “immediate family” as the
Employee’s spouse, parent, child, sibling; the Employee’s spouse’s parent, child, or sibling; the
Employee’s spouse’s grandparents or grandchildren. Special consideration will also be given to
any person whose association with the Employee was similar to any of the above relationships.
The Company reserves the right to request documentation, such as an obituary or funeral
program, or a prayer card from the Employee. These should be submitted at the time of
request or upon return from leave. As an alternative to this documentation, you may provide
the name of the deceased, date of death, city of death, and relationship to the deceased within
the request.

After receiving the approved request, the Human Resources Department will submit the
Bereavement days in your personnel profile under the PTO section. This will not deduct from
your PTO balance.
o Sun Tan City – MyGlow
o Buff City Soap – MyGlow
o Crunch Fitness – Woven

Military Leave
A military leave of absence will be granted to Employees who are absent from work because of
service in the U.S. uniformed services in accordance with the Uniformed Services Employment
and Reemployment Rights Act (USERRA). Advance notice of military service is required, unless
military necessity prevents such notice, or it is otherwise impossible or unreasonable. The leave
will be unpaid. Employees may use available PTO for the absence. Benefit accruals will be
suspended during the leave and will resume once returned to active employment. Contact
Human Resources for information or questions about military leave.
